problem: Initial resources, Renown, and Rank are not represented as executable draft state.
rootCause: No approved project decision authorizes deterministic initialization of Resources and Rank. Renown behavior is blocked by unresolved source ambiguities and an incomplete creation-mechanics review. The prototype candidate-confirmed mechanics have not been promoted to approved status.

decisionGovernance.decisionBoundary: Approves only IMPLEMENT-019A deterministic Resources and Rank initialization. Does not approve Renown, completion validation, identity fields, ledger, persistence, publication, installation, activation, or Campaign binding.

implement019aScope.description: Deterministic initial Resources and Rank initialization.

implement019aExpectedProductionChanges: WerewolfResourceRankInitialization.cs: retain Gnosis/Rage/Willpower derivation and Rank=Cliath/1; remove all Renown logic
WerewolfReferenceRuntime.cs: retain Enabled registration and dispatch for character-creation.initialize-resources-and-rank
WerewolfCharacterCreationDraftInitializer.cs: retain RequiredNextSteps with initialize-resources-and-rank; retain null Resources/Rank until operation executes; remove RenownKeys
implement019aRequiredTests: Gnosis: homid->1, metis->3, lupus->5; UnsupportedRace for unknown Race
Rage: ragabash->1, theurge->2, philodox->3, galliard->4, ahroun->5; UnsupportedAuspice for unknown Auspice
Atomicity: draft version increments exactly once; unrelated state preserved
Renown exclusion: Renown dictionary remains null/unset after operation
No Renown operation registered or dispatched
No Ragabash Renown warnings or findings emitted
Build: dotnet build and dotnet test pass with no new warnings
implement019aCompletionCriteria: Production code stripped of Renown logic

implement019bBlockedBoundary.description: Initial Renown is not approved for implementation in the current slice.

classifications.behavior: Initial temporary Renown values for any Auspice

implement019bBlockedBoundary.structuralPresence: Renown may remain structurally present in the draft contract with null/unset values. IMPLEMENT-019A must not initialize, interpret, validate, serialize as behavior, emit findings, or emit next steps for Renown.
implement019bBlockedBoundary.completionRequirements: Completion requirements involving Renown are outside this decision and belong to the future completion-validation work package.
